tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures favor a sink-inhibited siphon coupled to a memory state. The trajectory batch adds time-resolved observations that can distinguish memory coupling from its decay rate near the target horizon, where the five pilot endpoints alone cannot reliably separate them.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations at similar horizons give no residual degrees of freedom and weakly distinguish memory coupling from its relaxation timescale.
The static law captures gradient inhibition but cannot account for the observed transient lag or dependence on the initial state.
It does not resolve the ambiguity between memory coupling and relaxation.
